subject: Operations
title: Third-Party Logistics
description: A micro-lesson that makes Third-Party Logistics usable.

hook.text: A startup has no warehouse and no trucks. It ships 10,000 orders a month. How? A 3PL handles everything.

buildup.text: Third-party logistics providers store, pick, pack, and ship on behalf of other companies.

discovery.text: 3PLs offer scale advantages: shared warehouses, bulk shipping rates, and established technology platforms.

twist.text: Outsourcing logistics means losing direct control. If the 3PL fails, your brand takes the hit, not theirs.

climax.text: 4PLs go further—managing the entire supply chain including multiple 3PLs, carriers, and tech integrations.

punchline.text: Outsource the trucks. Keep control of the brand.
